# UCLA School of Theater, Film and Television

> > UCLA's premier institution for cinematic arts, theater, and media studies, offering undergraduate and graduate programs in film production, theater performance, and media scholarship.

UCLA School of Theater, Film and Television (TFT) is a leading creative education institution offering BA, MFA, and PhD programs in film, television, digital media, theater, and cinema studies. The school maintains strong connections to the entertainment industry through faculty like Ruth E. Carter and programs supporting emerging artists, with notable presence at festivals like Sundance and recognition through awards like the Class Artist competition.

## Key Topics

- Film, Television & Digital Media
- UCLA TFT Department of Theater
- Cinema & Media Studies
- MFA Graduate Programs
- Film Directing
- Musical Theater
- Documentary Production
- Costume Design
- Animation Education
- Class Artist Competition
- Sundance Film Festival
- DGA (Directors Guild of America)
- Ray Bolger Program
- Entertainment Industry Partnerships
- Digital Media Production

- [Film, Television & Digital Media (BA)](https://www.tft.ucla.edu/filmba): Film, TV & Digital Media BA application info for undergraduates
- [Cinema & Media Studies (PhD)](https://www.tft.ucla.edu/programs/cinema-media-studies-phd): Cinema & Media Studies PhD program overview and requirements
- [Theater BA: Musical Theater Emphasis](https://www.tft.ucla.edu/programs/theater-ba/musical-theater-emphasis): Theater BA with Musical Theater emphasis via Ray Bolger Program
